IIST CAMPUS · VERSION 15

Built from the map.

Walk with WASD or the arrow keys. Press B or tap Skateboard to ride. Hold Shift to run or boost. Jump with Space. On a phone, use the movement pad and the Run or Boost button. Walk or skate into the football to kick it. At the cafeteria counter, press E or tap Buy tea to spend pretend campus coins. Time → Auto runs one campus day in one real hour; Weather lets you choose automatic showers, clear skies or rain.

Press I or tap Show student ID near a gate. Clearance covers leaving and returning through that gate. The armed checkpoint interaction is fictional.

The building outlines and entrances follow annotated campus views. Elevations, architectural details and the outer road approaches are approximate. Select a place on the map to visit it.
